conditional_input_fields.agent_id: Present ONLY when the hook fires inside a subagent call. A main-thread Stop carries no agent identity, which is what makes its ABSENCE the usable signal.
conditional_input_fields.agent_type: Present when the session uses --agent or the hook fires inside a subagent. Note a session-wide --agent makes this present on a MAIN-THREAD stop too, so agent_type alone does not mean 'in a subagent' -- agent_id does.
conditional_input_fields.effort: In the example, but present only when the current model supports the effort parameter.

notes: reason is REQUIRED when decision is 'block'. hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext is non-error feedback that continues the conversation.

input_example.last_assistant_message: I've completed the refactoring. Here's a summary...
